proof_body:
by
  intro r t
  have hr : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => r * s) (r * 1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul r
  have he : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (r * s)) (Real.exp (r * t) * (r * 1)) t := hr.exp
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => s * Real.exp (r * s))
      (1 * Real.exp (r * t) + t * (Real.exp (r * t) * (r * 1))) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id' t).mul he
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + r * s) * Real.exp (r * s))
      ((r * 1) * Real.exp (r * t) + (1 + r * t) * (Real.exp (r * t) * (r * 1))) t :=
    (hr.const_add 1).mul he
  exact ⟨h1.congr_deriv (by ring), h2.congr_deriv (by ring)⟩
target_source: ∀ (r t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s => s * Real.exp (r * s)) ((1 + r * t) * Real.exp (r * t)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => (1 + r * s) * Real.exp (r * s)) (2 * r * ((1 + r * t) * Real.exp (r * t)) - r ^ 2 * (t * Real.exp (r * t))) t
